## Safety and release boundary

- [ ] Fixtures, identifiers, URLs, and timestamps are fictional
- [ ] No credential, database, recipient data, private log, or production screenshot is included
- [ ] Copied or adapted material and its license are disclosed
- [ ] Documentation and both supported languages remain consistent
- [ ] No deployment or real notification was triggered by this pull request
- [ ] Sender acceptance is not described as proof of handset display
